title: Grateful Dead Live at Silver Dollar Fair on 1968-11-01

ai_review.summary: High‑quality soundboard capture (with a dip after New Potato) that showcases an epic The Other One and a stellar Caution > Feedback > Goodnight sequence.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised as the best‑sounding of the six available versions, though the fidelity drops once New Potato begins and Bob Weir’s guitar sits low in the mix. Musically it’s a “dark horse” show highlighted by an astonishingly ferocious The Other One and a compelling Caution > Feedback > Goodnight medley, with Garcia‑Lesh interplay described as off‑the‑charts brilliant.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviewers rave about the performance (especially The Other One) and rate it highly, while noting a noticeable drop in sound quality partway through; overall balance yields a strong rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp and clear at the start, considered the best of six posted versions; however sound quality plummets after New Potato begins and Bob's guitar is often buried in the mix.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A powerful first half that fades technically, followed by a soaring second half where Garcia and Lesh lock in brilliantly; the Caution>Feedback>Goodnight segment adds extra momentum.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s playing on The Other One is described as monumental with off‑the‑charts interplay with Phil.
band_member_comments.Phil: Lesh’s bass work shines through, noted for creative interplay with Garcia.
band_member_comments.Bob: His guitar is largely buried in the mix, though his presence is still felt.
